sentences.text: % 17.11.2023 CRL.M.(BAIL) 1480/2023 (for interim bail)
1. The petitioner/Himmat Singh is seeking interim bail for a period of 03 months due to medical condition of his mother who is stated to be diagnosed with Cancer Stage-IV.

The petitioner is in judicial custody in FIR bearing no.0929/2021 registered under sections 498A/304B/34 IPC at P.S.
Alipur.

The trial is stated to be pending in the court of Sh. Satvir Singh Lamba, CMM, Rohini Courts,
Delhi/Successor Court.
2.
It is stated that the mother of the petitioner/Himmat Singh is in very critical condition and due to this reason, the petitioner prayed that he be granted interim bail for a period of 03 months.

3. The respondent/State filed the Status Report wherein the physical condition of the mother of the petitioner/Himmat Singh was verified and it is mentioned that mother of the petitioner is suffering from Cancer and requires Radiotherapy (5 days a week) with weekly Chemotherapy as detailed in para no.5 of the Status Report dated 10.11.2023.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/11/2023 at 21:50:44 4.

After considering the facts, the petitioner/Himmat Singh is admitted to interim bail till 10.01.2024 on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial court on the following conditions:-

sentences.text: That the petitioner shall not leave the country without prior permission of the court.
II. The petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence or try to influence the witness and shall participate in the trial unless and until his personal appearance is exempted by the trial court.
III. The petitioner shall provide his mobile phone number to the Investigating Officer (IO) concerned - at the time of release, which shall be kept in working condition at all times.
The petitioner shall not switch-off, or change the sim without prior intimation to the IO concerned, during the period of interim bail.
IV. The petitioner shall not indulge in any criminal activity during the suspension period.
5. The petitioner is directed to surrender before the concerned jail authority on 11.01.2024 at 02:30 P.M.
6. The present application stands disposed of.
7. The date already fixed, i.e. 30.11.2023 stands cancelled.
Dasti.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J NOVEMBER 17, 2023 j/ak
